correctness.rationale: Universality and exact ultrahomogeneity identify injective tuple orbits with labeled finite diversities. A direct strict-slack construction gives a full-dimensional local diversity box; coordinate projection to pairs then has exact local fiber dimension m_n-binomial(n,2). The n=3 interval is an exact specialization of the axioms.
